title: Strict Tower Realization
statement:
Let $(A,I)$ be the adic datum of [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], with $P_n=A/I^n$, completed coefficient sheaves $A_T$, and strict quotient towers. Let $f:X\to Y$ be separated of finite type, $g:Y'\to Y$ any scheme map, and $X'=X\times_YY'$ with projections $f',g'$ [def-cbc-compact-support-square]. Supply a compactification $c=(j:X\hookrightarrow\overline X,p:\overline X\to Y)$ and its base change $c'=(j',p')$, with ambient map $\bar g$ [def-weil-pbc-projection-compactification]. Let $K\in D(\operatorname{Mod}(A_X))$ be derived $I$-complete [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion], with compatible witnesses $\nu_X^*L_n\simeq K_n$, $L_n\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},P_n)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness]. Assume $j_!K$ is complete and identify its quotient tower with $j_!K_\bullet$ using the canonical tensor comparisons. Here $j_!$ is the exact ringed-site functor of [lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact].
Put $\mathcal T_T=\operatorname{Tow}(\underline A_T)$ and let $\operatorname{Res}_T$ restrict along $\underline A_T\to A_T$ [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence]. Use constant-coefficient strict-tower operations $G_u,R_u^{\mathcal T}$ and $J_j$ [def-cbc-strict-constant-tower-operations, def-cbc-strict-tower-open-extension]. Restriction of scalars canonically commutes with $j_!$ on sheaves, complexes, and strict towers. For $M_\bullet=\operatorname{Res}_X K_\bullet$ define the actual strict-tower morphism
$$e^c_M=(R_{p'}^{\mathcal T}\beta_{j,\bar g})\circ E_p^{\mathcal T}:G_gR_p^{\mathcal T}J_jM_\bullet\longrightarrow R_{p'}^{\mathcal T}J_{j'}G_{g'}M_\bullet,$$
where $E_p^{\mathcal T}$ is the normalized proper mate [lem-weil-pbc-strict-tower-exchange-mate-normalization] and $\beta$ the open unit-mate [lem-cbc-strict-tower-proper-open-calculus]. The ordered completed exchange $\operatorname{Ex}^{\mathrm{comp},c}_!(K)$ of [def-cbc-completed-exchange-map], with its open factor specified by the ordered $R\lim(\beta)$ formula, is exactly the image of $R\lim(e^c_M)$ under the canonical constant/completed, finite-reduction, direct-image/limit, and extension/limit identifications [prop-weil-pbc-direct-image-limits, lem-cbc-exact-product-functor-strict-limit]. This identification is natural in $K$ and identifies evaluation of $e^c_M$ at each $n$ with the specified finite proper/open exchange; it does not characterize a tower map only by evaluations.

proof.text: Put $F=j_!K$. Its assumed intrinsic completeness gives $\operatorname{comp}_F:F\simeq R\lim F_\bullet$ by unit-compatible Koszul reconstruction. Its witnesses are $j_!^{\mathrm{et}}L_n$: etale extension is exact, and the natural open site comparison descends degreewise since both comparison pullback and open extension are exact. Thus $\nu_{\overline X}^*j_!^{\mathrm{et}}L_n\simeq j_!K_n=F_n$, with the given transitions and each individual lower bound. Apply the scalar/open comparison of [lem-cbc-ringed-open-scalar-limit-coherence] to identify $\operatorname{Res}F_\bullet=J_jM_\bullet$.

source.place: First sentence and its parenthetical witness check; use the assumed completeness and unit-compatible reconstruction rather than deducing completeness merely from exactness.

proof.text: The proper square and $F$ now satisfy [lem-weil-pbc-strict-tower-exchange-mate-normalization]. The completed-exchange definition uses exactly its $H,H'$ and $v=H'\mathcal R(e_F)H^{-1}$. Hence its specified $b,d$ give $d\operatorname{Res}(v)=E_p^{\mathcal T}b$ before evaluation. Here $b,d$ use [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence] and $c$ is that of [prop-weil-pbc-direct-image-limits]. The definition's ordered proper factor is therefore $\gamma_F=c_N^{-1}\mathcal L(E_p^{\mathcal T})s_K$, under scalar restriction (Step 3 identifies $c$), where $N=G_{\bar g}J_jM_\bullet$ and $s_K$ includes $\mathcal L(b)$.

source.place: Proper factor of the ordered composite; strict H,H prime realization in the current DAG definition and proper normalization statement. Stacks 0A07 supplies the direct-image/limit comparison, not the additional strict mate equality.

proof.text: Both opens are quasi-compact by the completed-exchange definition. Apply [lem-cbc-completed-open-strict-mate-identification] to their open square: for $N'=J_{j'}G_{g'}M_\bullet$ its actual strict map is $\beta:N\to N'$, and its ordered completed factor is $\lambda_{j'}^{-1}\mathcal L(\beta)$. The scalar/open limit square of [lem-cbc-ringed-open-scalar-limit-coherence] identifies the extension comparisons and their completion units. Apply [lem-cbc-flat-scalar-direct-image-limit-coherence] to $p'$: coefficient flatness is supplied by constant/completed equivalence, exact countable products hold on pro-etale module sheaves, and the coefficient identifications are those of the direct-image/limit proposition. Thus its completed comparison restricts to $c$.

source.place: Final open factor, with the ordered Rlim(beta) normalization required in the item; compare the current blueprint open-comparison proof, last paragraph, replacing its incorrect sectionwise justification by Steps 5-6.

proof.text:
Naturality gives $c_{N'}Rp'_*(\mathcal L\beta)=\mathcal L(R_{p'}^{\mathcal T}\beta)c_N$. Substitute the two ordered factors into the definition, cancel $c_Nc_N^{-1}$, and use functoriality of $\mathcal L=R\lim$:
$$\operatorname{Ex}^{\mathrm{comp},c}_!(K)=t_K\mathcal L((R_{p'}^{\mathcal T}\beta)E_p^{\mathcal T})s_K,\qquad t_K=Rp'_*(\lambda_{j'}^{-1})c_{N'}^{-1}.$$
These are the specified endpoint comparisons, so this is the asserted equality of morphisms.

source.place: Tag 0A07 (lemma-Rf-commutes-with-Rlim), natural comparison; substitution in the ordered compact-support definition. The composition identity is functoriality on strict towers.

proof.text: All factors are natural in $K$. Evaluation preserves the already constructed composite: proper normalization gives its specified finite proper factor, as its lift has the finite evaluations $v'_n$ of [def-weil-pbc-completed-base-change-map], and the strict open calculus gives its inverse-unit finite open factor. Their ordered composite is the required finite exchange. No reconstruction from evaluations is used.

source.place: Evaluation and naturality of the two specified factors; the proper lift and strict open-unit mate are fixed before evaluation.

tool_uses.why: Generic exact ringed-site open adjunction supplies the very j_! stipulated in the item, including non-finite coefficients.
Generic descent of an exact functor justifies degreewise open comparisons on unbounded derived categories.
Generic coefficient and finite-reduction comparison keeps constant and completed coefficients distinct and identifies the specified tower units.
Exact etale extension preserves each witness lower bound; the unit requires these witnesses and does not replace this general sheaf theorem.
Generic functorial derived inverse limit permits composition of actual tower maps for constant coefficient sheaves.
Proper base-change strict mate normalization is the proper factor explicitly required by the unit route.
Generic pro-etale module countable-product exactness verifies the hypotheses of the normalized strict-limit comparison.
Generic natural direct-image/limit comparison is needed to compose the proper and open factors on strict towers.
Unit-compatible reconstruction converts the assumed intrinsic completeness of j_!K to the quotient-unit hypothesis of proper normalization.
Exactness of finite-coefficient etale/pro-etale comparison pullback justifies the degreewise witness comparison on derived categories.
